title: URTS
query: What is the purpose of the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: The purpose of the URTS-Composite scheme is to provide financial assistance for the installation of rooftop solar systems with project sizes above 3 kW to 25 kW.

title: URTS
query: What is the maximum loan amount available under the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: The maximum loan amount under the URTS-Composite scheme is up to Rs. 15 lakhs.

title: URTS
query: Who is eligible to apply for the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: Eligible applicants for the URTS-Composite scheme include existing home loan borrowers, individuals with a CIC score of 680 and above (including new-to-bank applicants), bank staff, and those with sufficient area as per MNRE guidelines, along with a recent electricity bill.

title: URTS
query: What is the rate of interest for the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: The rate of interest for the URTS-Composite scheme is as applicable under Union Home loans.

title: URTS
query: What is the maximum quantum of finance for the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: Under the URTS-Composite scheme, borrowers can finance up to 80% of the project cost as per the MNRE-approved dealer.

title: URTS
query: What is the margin required for the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: The required margin under the URTS-Composite scheme is 20% of the project cost, including equipment and installation.

title: URTS
query: What is the repayment period for the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: The maximum repayment period for the URTS-Composite scheme is 10 years.

title: URTS
query: Is there a moratorium period for the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: Yes, the URTS-Composite scheme includes a 6-month moratorium period.

title: URTS
query: Is there a subsidy available for the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: Yes, there is a subsidy of Rs. 78,000 for the URTS-Composite scheme, which borrowers can claim using their loan account number.

title: URTS
query: What security is required under the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: The security requirement includes hypothecation of the rooftop solar system and a general lien over the title deed of the property offered in the existing home loan.

title: URTS
query: What is the net annual income requirement for the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: Income documentation is required as per the income documents provided by the applicant.

title: URTS
query: What are the processing charges for the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: The processing charge for the URTS-Composite scheme is 0.50% of the loan amount plus GST.

title: URTS
query: How is the loan amount disbursed under the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: The loan amount is disbursed directly to the vendor or EPC contractor after the submission of required feasibility reports as mandated by MNRE. The disbursement includes the loan amount and borrower margin, while the subsidy is claimed by the borrower/vendor.

title: URTS
query: What other covenants are included in the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: The URTS-Composite scheme is sourced through the Jan Samarth Portal and is available for both customer-initiated and assisted journeys.

title: URTS
query: Is there an in-principle offer for the URTS-Composite scheme?
response: No, there is no in-principle offer available for the URTS-Composite scheme.
